verdict.rationale: A shared whiteboard is a fair capability to ask of a project and issue-tracking product, but the evidence pack never documents a whiteboard or visual canvas in Linear. Related items do not deliver the story: the Figma integration links issues to a separate tool, and commenting on images in issue descriptions is a different feature, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a designer, I can collaborate visually with my team on a shared whiteboard
